title: Efficient and Minimax Optimal In-context Nonparametric Regression with Transformers
summary: We study in-context learning for nonparametric regression with $α$-Hölder smooth regression functions, for some $α>0$. We prove that, with $n$ in-context examples and $d$-dimensional regression covariates, a pretrained transformer with $Θ(\log n)$ parameters and $Ω\bigl(n^{2α/(2α+d)}\log^3 n\bigr)$ pretraining sequences can achieve the minimax optimal rate of convergence $O\bigl(n^{-2α/(2α+d)}\bigr)$ in mean squared error.
